name: report_review_issue
description: Report an issue with a Hlido review (stale info, wrong verdict, missing claim, broken link). Use when calling get_scorecard or trust_check returns data you can prove is incorrect. Hlido's R1 maintenance routine processes reports daily and fires re-tests via dispute-retest sub-agent.

name: request_quick_audit
description: Request that Hlido audit a NEW AI agent that has no review yet. Free-tier rate-limited (5/day per anonymous, 50/day per identified).

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: trust_check, verify_transparency, get_incidents, find_similar_agents · Private data: find_similar_agents, scan_mcp, intel_query · Public sink: submit_agent, subscribe · Destructive: scan_mcp.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: trust_check, verify_transparency, get_incidents, find_similar_agents · Private data: find_similar_agents, scan_mcp, intel_query · Public sink: submit_agent, subscribe · Destructive: scan_mcp

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
